name: io.github.chrischall/evite-mcp
description: Evite for Claude — list events, guest lists & RSVPs, RSVP, message guests, and create/edit events

environmentVariables.name: EVITE_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Your Evite login email address. Optional — if omitted, the server falls back to a raw session cookie or the fetchproxy browser bridge (requires being signed in to evite.com).

environmentVariables.name: EVITE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your Evite password. Optional — see EVITE_EMAIL.

environmentVariables.name: EVITE_SESSION_COOKIE
environmentVariables.description: A raw `cookie:` header copied from a signed-in evite.com tab (alternative to email/password). Used verbatim. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: EVITE_SESSION_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk session cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

environmentVariables.name: EVITE_SESSION_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the session cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.evite-mcp/session.json.

environmentVariables.name: EVITE_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to disable the fetchproxy browser bridge. With the bridge disabled you MUST provide EVITE_EMAIL/EVITE_PASSWORD or EVITE_SESSION_COOKIE. Defaults to false.

environmentVariables.name: EVITE_UPLOAD_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Restrict evite_upload_photo to image files inside this directory (several may be separated by the path delimiter, `:` on macOS/Linux; `~` allowed). A path outside it is refused before anything is read. Unset = any readable image file.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
